title: What Are Little Girls Made Of
author: Carolyn VanEseltine

archive.primary: Ectocomp_2012/What Are Little Girls Made Of.z8

description: Avril's Funasium sounds more like a bouncy castle than an amusement park, but it's really an amusement park - one with a bouncy castle, and an arcade, and four roller coasters, and a haunted house.  There's a much bigger line at the haunted house tonight because it's Halloween, but you think that's dumb.  It's not a very good haunted house, because you can see most of the springs and wires and things.
